name: Brecheniauc
text: Brecheniauc is an older spelling for the medieval Welsh kingdom known as Brycheiniog. This form names the same sovereign territory, a domain laid out in the Usk valley. Readers who meet this land should turn to the entry for Brycheiniog.

attributes.attribute: the older name form of the medieval Welsh kingdom of Brycheiniog

okr.objective: Explain Brecheniauc as the older name form of the medieval Welsh kingdom of Brycheiniog and direct the reader to the Brycheiniog entry.
key_results: Brecheniauc names the same Usk-valley kingdom as Brycheiniog
